images.prompt: EDIT this exact people-free supermarket image into the clean empty master for a vertical 9:16 animated short. Preserve the same inviting cartoon supermarket composition, familiar render style and palette, window arches, fruit crates in lower corners, shelving, lights, paired counters, floor tile perspective and cyan left/amber right painted checkout lanes. Make the smallest changes possible: remove any letter-like details on packaging and keep all elements clean and sharp. If needed, clarify the luminous inner edges of both floor lanes as smooth straight lines running from the counters to their original foreground corners. Lock the reference camera, vanishing point and framing; keep counters and floor stripes in the exact same pixel positions and widths as the attached image. Absolutely empty of people, silhouettes, carts, baskets, arrows, text, labels and logos. Both counters fully visible and comparable in height. Preserve headroom above counters for an editorial overlay. Single finished high-quality 2D illustration in the supplied tall portrait aspect ratio, preferably 1080x1920 or highest available native resolution, full bleed.

Edit this supplied EMPTY MASTER as a locked background plate. Output ONE entire finished frame, full bleed 9:16 (target 1080×1920 or best native portrait available). Add fully drawn people and grounded props in the same warm colorful cartoon supermarket. Preserve exact frame boundaries and every uncovered pixel of the whole store as far as possible. Do not move, rescale, redraw or extend either colored floor lane, the floor tiles, registers, fruit crates, shelves, ceiling lights or windows. No text. This frame is a clear fork between two loaded metal shopping carts and five tiny orange hand baskets. Two small teal-uniform cashiers behind the counters. Both lanes recede toward the back, same single vanishing point. On BLUE left lane exactly TWO shoppers: near the left counter a smaller man with a teal/navy jacket and one full wheeled cart, and further back towards camera a noticeably larger woman in cream and purple with another full wheeled cart. Align both carts with the lane; neither cart floats. On ORANGE right lane exactly FIVE adults waiting in order, each holding ONE clearly visible small handled handbasket. From farthest at the counter to nearest: mustard sweater woman, olive jacket man, plum sweater man, teal blouse woman, light lilac shirt man. Space them diagonally within the lane so heads AND five small baskets can be counted, with faces or backs turned toward checkout. Mild left/right stagger within the ORANGE lane, not across the central aisle. One additional focal person standing in the central foreground aisle before choosing: young brown-haired man, bright red and black plaid shirt, blue jeans, white sneakers, muted green backpack, one small basket low in left hand, head turned toward amber line, right hand resting at his chin. His shoes firmly contact the same tile plane. Perspective check in normalized frame coordinates with (0,0) upper left: roughly position the right five pairs of feet progressively deeper to nearer around y=37%, 44%, 51%, 58%, 66%; relative full body image heights roughly 8%, 10%, 13%, 16%, 19% respectively, real adult proportions. Red-plaid man has feet near 84% of frame height and body ~28% of frame height. Foreground adults visibly larger than distant adults, scaling head, torso, legs and basket together. Equivalent cart at distance looks markedly smaller than nearest cart. Perspective and legible figures take priority over exact pixel coordinates. Keep heads clear of top 22% reserved for captions and generated lettering. Integrate shoes, wheels and short contact shadows into the floor, no floating or giant people at the registers. Only the people, shopping objects and their shadows are additions.

Precision local edit of Image 1, the entire opening frame. Image 2 is the empty reference of this exact store; use it to recover the exact exposed floor tiles in the patch where the hero was standing. Output a single full finished portrait 9:16 frame at the same resolution and framing as Image 1. Only change the red-plaid man's pose and position. He just stepped diagonally toward the orange queue and takes the last place, behind the tall lilac-shirt man. Locate his feet near y=85%, centered at x=78% of the frame, with his whole body, head, white sneakers and small orange basket readable on-screen; his torso may be a little left of the amber lane's imaginary extension. He faces the right register in a 3/4 rear view, chin hand now relaxed, same red plaid, blue jeans, olive backpack. At almost the same depth as before, keep his original height, torso and head size. Let the two men be visibly separate with only modest overlap, keeping the lilac man's basket and shoes legible. Remove the previous red-plaid figure and his old shadow completely, revealing the exact original tile grid of the empty anchor. Preserve both cashiers, all seven other customers, every basket and cart, all their identities, scale, positions and clothing, and every fixed detail and edge of the cyan and amber lanes exactly. Do not redraw, pan, zoom or crop. No text. This is a finished cartoon supermarket frame with the change painted into the scene.

Four basket shoppers remain ahead of the red-plaid protagonist, from farthest to nearest: olive jacket, plum sweater, teal blouse, lilac shirt. Seen mostly from behind in 3/4 view, the plum shopper holds a plain debit card between fingers in his right hand, reaching a little upward to tap it against the small black card reader that the same teal-uniform right cashier extends just over the counter toward him. Make the contact between card and reader clear and anatomically natural, the reader within easy reach. His left hand still holds the original small orange shopping basket at thigh level.
